label: sparse conjunctive code: g-related contexts (copy-phase g input, <DEL> in g-initial sequences)
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.09% of steps) whose firing is enriched but not determined by token g: input g has 11x lift (34% of mass), first_tok g has 11x lift (37% of mass), and the <DEL> step has 3x lift (25% of mass). Other inputs with lift are 3, h, x (original phase), and the previous token is often 1, r or p. The strongest top examples are g-initial sequences containing e/v/1/p, where it fires on the last original tokens, on <DEL>, and on the first copied g. No simple predicate gets precision above ~10%: most g inputs and most <DEL> steps in g-initial sequences do not activate it. Copy-phase g inputs whose output is e/v/n/g/u/x reach only F1 ~0.12. It never fires at t=0 or t=1 and is rare late in long copies. Magnitude is fairly flat (median 0.12, max 0.30). The highest activations are at <DEL> and the first copied g of g-initial sequences.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=g (+8.38), orig0=g (+4.74), t=2 & prev_tok=1 (+4.51), orig0=e (+3.49), prev_tok=1 (+3.21), orig0=n (+2.75). Lower it: recall_idx=1 & in_tok=g (-4.82), phase=2 (-4.49), prev_tok=e (-3.57), prev3_tok=- (-3.51).
